examples.hanzi: 你的发音很标准，一点口音也没有。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de fāyīn hěn biāozhǔn, yīdiǎn kǒuyīn yě méiyǒu.
examples.english: Your pronunciation is very standard, with no accent at all.

examples.hanzi: 这个字有两种发音，意思也不同。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zì yǒu liǎng zhǒng fāyīn, yìsi yě bùtóng.
examples.english: This character has two pronunciations with different meanings.

examples.hanzi: 他怀疑自己的手机里被装了窃听器。
examples.pinyin: Tā huáiyí zìjǐ de shǒujī lǐ bèi zhuāng le qiètīngqì.
examples.english: He suspects a bugging device was installed in his phone.

examples.hanzi: 侦探在电话线上发现了一个小窃听器。
examples.pinyin: Zhēntàn zài diànhuà xiàn shàng fāxiàn le yī gè xiǎo qiètīngqì.
examples.english: The detective found a small bug on the telephone line.

examples.hanzi: 联合国呼吁各国共同保护环境。
examples.pinyin: Liánhéguó hūyù gè guó gòngtóng bǎohù huánjìng.
examples.english: The United Nations calls on all countries to protect the environment together.

examples.hanzi: 她在联合国担任翻译工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Liánhéguó dānrèn fānyì gōngzuò.
examples.english: She works as an interpreter at the United Nations.

examples.hanzi: 他们一家人周末去森林里打猎。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yī jiā rén zhōumò qù sēnlín lǐ dǎliè.
examples.english: The family goes hunting in the forest on weekends.

examples.hanzi: 现在很多地方不允许随便打猎。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō dìfang bù yǔnxǔ suíbiàn dǎliè.
examples.english: Nowadays, hunting is not allowed everywhere without permission.

examples.hanzi: 我们终于渡过了最困难的时期。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōngyú dùguò le zuì kùnnan de shíqī.
examples.english: We finally got through the most difficult period.

examples.hanzi: 他在国外渡过了愉快的童年。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài guówài dùguò le yúkuài de tóngnián.
examples.english: He spent a happy childhood abroad.

examples.hanzi: 这份机密文件被人泄漏给了媒体。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn jīmì wénjiàn bèi rén xièlòu gěi le méitǐ.
examples.english: This confidential document was leaked to the media.

examples.hanzi: 煤气泄漏时，要马上开窗通风。
examples.pinyin: Méiqì xièlòu shí, yào mǎshàng kāichuāng tōngfēng.
examples.english: When there is a gas leak, open the windows for ventilation immediately.

examples.hanzi: 怪不得他不高兴，原来你忘了他的生日。
examples.pinyin: Guàibude tā bù gāoxìng, yuánlái nǐ wàng le tā de shēngrì.
examples.english: No wonder he's unhappy, you forgot his birthday.

examples.hanzi: 他在国外住了十年，怪不得英语这么好。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài guówài zhù le shí nián, guàibude Yīngyǔ zhème hǎo.
examples.english: He lived abroad for ten years, so no wonder his English is so good.

examples.hanzi: 他在海军陆战队服役了四年。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài hǎijūn lùzhànduì fúyì le sì nián.
examples.english: He served four years in the Marine Corps.

examples.hanzi: 陆战队员在海滩上进行了登陆训练。
examples.pinyin: Lùzhànduì yuán zài hǎitān shàng jìnxíng le dēnglù xùnliàn.
examples.english: The marines carried out landing drills on the beach.

examples.hanzi: 洗手要用肥皂搓二十秒。
examples.pinyin: Xǐshǒu yào yòng féizào cuō èrshí miǎo.
examples.english: When washing your hands, scrub with soap for twenty seconds.

examples.hanzi: 请问，洗手间在哪里？我想洗手。
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, xǐshǒujiān zài nǎlǐ? Wǒ xiǎng xǐshǒu.
examples.english: Excuse me, where is the restroom? I want to wash my hands.

examples.hanzi: 这档节目的海选吸引了上万人报名。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dàng jiémù de hǎixuǎn xīyǐn le shàng wàn rén bàomíng.
examples.english: The open audition for this show attracted tens of thousands of sign-ups.

examples.hanzi: 她在海选中唱了一首老歌，评委都很喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài hǎixuǎn zhōng chàng le yī shǒu lǎo gē, píngwěi dōu hěn xǐhuan.
examples.english: She sang an old song at the open audition, and the judges loved it.

examples.hanzi: 他今天考试时发挥失常，成绩很差。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān kǎoshì shí fāhuī shīcháng, chéngjì hěn chà.
examples.english: He performed below par in the exam today and his score was poor.

examples.hanzi: 机器的运转有些失常，需要检修。
examples.pinyin: Jīqì de yùnzhuàn yǒuxiē shīcháng, xūyào jiǎnxiū.
examples.english: The machine is running abnormally and needs servicing.

examples.hanzi: 《猫》是一部很受欢迎的音乐剧。
examples.pinyin: 《Māo》 shì yī bù hěn shòu huānyíng de yīnyuèjù.
examples.english: Cats is a very popular musical.

examples.hanzi: 她从小就想演音乐剧。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù xiǎng yǎn yīnyuèjù.
examples.english: She has wanted to act in musicals since childhood.

examples.hanzi: 新政策正在逐步推进。
examples.pinyin: Xīn zhèngcè zhèngzài zhúbù tuījìn.
examples.english: The new policy is being pushed forward step by step.

examples.hanzi: 火箭靠强大的动力推进。
examples.pinyin: Huǒjiàn kào qiángdà de dònglì tuījìn.
examples.english: The rocket is propelled by powerful engines.

examples.hanzi: 冰淇淋放久了会融化。
examples.pinyin: Bīngqílín fàng jiǔ le huì rónghuà.
examples.english: Ice cream melts if left out too long.

examples.hanzi: 春天来了，河面上的冰开始融化。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, hémiàn shàng de bīng kāishǐ rónghuà.
examples.english: Spring has come and the ice on the river is starting to melt.

examples.hanzi: 他在门外敲了半天门。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài ménwài qiāo le bàntiān mén.
examples.english: He knocked on the door outside for a long time.

examples.hanzi: 门外停着一辆很旧的自行车。
examples.pinyin: Ménwài tíng zhe yī liàng hěn jiù de zìxíngchē.
examples.english: A very old bicycle is parked outside the door.

examples.hanzi: 前方两百米有一个红绿灯。
examples.pinyin: Qiánfāng liǎng bǎi mǐ yǒu yī gè hónglǜdēng.
examples.english: There is a traffic light two hundred meters ahead.

examples.hanzi: 我们要朝着前方的目标努力。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào cháo zhe qiánfāng de mùbiāo nǔlì.
examples.english: We should work toward the goal ahead.

examples.hanzi: 这道伤疤是我小时候摔倒留下的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào shāngbā shì wǒ xiǎoshíhou shuāidǎo liúxià de.
examples.english: This scar came from a fall when I was little.

examples.hanzi: 伤口好了以后，会留下一道浅浅的伤疤。
examples.pinyin: Shāngkǒu hǎo le yǐhòu, huì liúxià yī dào qiǎnqiǎn de shāngbā.
examples.english: After the wound heals, a faint scar will remain.

examples.hanzi: 动物园里的鳄鱼张开了大嘴。
examples.pinyin: Dòngwùyuán lǐ de èyú zhāng kāi le dà zuǐ.
examples.english: The crocodile in the zoo opened its big mouth.

examples.hanzi: 这个钱包是用鳄鱼皮做的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège qiánbāo shì yòng èyú pí zuò de.
examples.english: This wallet is made of crocodile skin.

examples.hanzi: 这条裤子太松了，要系一条皮带。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo kùzi tài sōng le, yào jì yī tiáo pídài.
examples.english: These trousers are too loose, so I need a belt.

examples.hanzi: 传送皮带坏了，机器停了下来。
examples.pinyin: Chuánsòng pídài huài le, jīqì tíng le xiàlái.
examples.english: The conveyor belt broke and the machine stopped.

examples.hanzi: 请随身携带你的身份证。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng suíshēn xiédài nǐ de shēnfènzhèng.
examples.english: Please carry your ID with you.

examples.hanzi: 飞机上的随身行李不能超过七公斤。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī shàng de suíshēn xíngli bù néng chāoguò qī gōngjīn.
examples.english: Carry-on luggage on the plane cannot exceed seven kilograms.

examples.hanzi: 吉米是我儿子的同班同学。
examples.pinyin: Jímǐ shì wǒ érzi de tóngbān tóngxué.
examples.english: Jimmy is my son's classmate.

examples.hanzi: 吉米昨天给我打了个电话，邀请我去他家。
examples.pinyin: Jímǐ zuótiān gěi wǒ dǎ le gè diànhuà, yāoqǐng wǒ qù tā jiā.
examples.english: Jimmy called me yesterday and invited me to his house.

examples.hanzi: 他为这个社区奉献了自己的时间和精力。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi zhège shèqū fèngxiàn le zìjǐ de shíjiān hé jīnglì.
examples.english: He dedicated his time and energy to this community.

examples.hanzi: 医生们的无私奉献让人感动。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēngmen de wúsī fèngxiàn ràng rén gǎndòng.
examples.english: The doctors' selfless dedication is moving.

examples.hanzi: 歹徒劫持了一辆公共汽车。
examples.pinyin: Dǎitú jiéchí le yī liàng gōnggòng qìchē.
examples.english: The criminals hijacked a bus.

examples.hanzi: 警察成功解救了被劫持的人质。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá chénggōng jiějiù le bèi jiéchí de rénzhì.
examples.english: The police successfully rescued the hostages who had been abducted.

examples.hanzi: 公共场所请不要大声说话。
examples.pinyin: Gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ qǐng bù yào dàshēng shuōhuà.
examples.english: Please do not talk loudly in public places.

examples.hanzi: 这里是举行婚礼的好场所。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ shì jǔxíng hūnlǐ de hǎo chǎngsuǒ.
examples.english: This is a good venue for a wedding.

examples.hanzi: 你可以把人民币转换成美元。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ bǎ rénmínbì zhuǎnhuàn chéng měiyuán.
examples.english: You can convert RMB into US dollars.

examples.hanzi: 换了新工作后，他需要时间转换角色。
examples.pinyin: Huàn le xīn gōngzuò hòu, tā xūyào shíjiān zhuǎnhuàn juésè.
examples.english: After changing jobs, he needs time to adjust to his new role.

examples.hanzi: 无论走到哪里，他都想念祖国。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn zǒu dào nǎlǐ, tā dōu xiǎngniàn zǔguó.
examples.english: Wherever he goes, he misses his motherland.

examples.hanzi: 运动员们为祖国赢得了荣誉。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòngyuánmen wèi zǔguó yíngdé le róngyù.
examples.english: The athletes won honor for their country.

examples.hanzi: 这支军团由五千名士兵组成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī jūntuán yóu wǔqiān míng shìbīng zǔchéng.
examples.english: This legion is made up of five thousand soldiers.

examples.hanzi: 游戏里的玩家可以加入不同的军团。
examples.pinyin: Yóuxì lǐ de wánjiā kěyǐ jiārù bùtóng de jūntuán.
examples.english: Players in the game can join different legions.

examples.pinyin: Bùlǎng tàitai měitiān zǎoshang dōu gěi huā jiāoshuǐ.
examples.english: Mrs. Brown waters the flowers every morning.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de tóngshì Bùlǎng shuō tā xià zhōu yào chūchāi.
examples.english: My colleague Brown said he's going on a business trip next week.

examples.hanzi: 我们先谈公事，再聊私事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān tán gōngshì, zài liáo sīshì.
examples.english: Let's discuss business first and then personal matters.

examples.hanzi: 他因为公事去了一趟上海。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi gōngshì qù le yī tàng Shànghǎi.
examples.english: He made a trip to Shanghai on business.

examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de jiéwěi tèbié gǎnrén.
examples.english: The ending of this movie is especially touching.

examples.hanzi: 他们之间有一段感人的友情。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zhījiān yǒu yī duàn gǎnrén de yǒuqíng.
examples.english: There is a moving friendship between them.

examples.pinyin: Gōngsī gěi wǒmen ānpái le Yīngyǔ péixùn.
examples.english: The company arranged English training for us.

examples.hanzi: 她正在培训班里学习做蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài péixùn bān lǐ xuéxí zuò dàngāo.
examples.english: She is learning to bake cakes in a training course.

examples.hanzi: 他及时传球给了站在前面的队友。
examples.pinyin: Tā jíshí chuánqiú gěi le zhàn zài qiánmiàn de duìyǒu.
examples.english: He passed the ball in time to the teammate standing in front.

examples.hanzi: 这位球员的传球非常精准。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi qiúyuán de chuánqiú fēicháng jīngzhǔn.
examples.english: This player's passing is very accurate.

examples.hanzi: 每天早上六点，闹钟准时响起。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang liù diǎn, nàozhōng zhǔnshí xiǎngqǐ.
examples.english: Every morning at six, the alarm goes off on time.

examples.hanzi: 现在是六点半，不是六点。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài shì liù diǎn bàn, bù shì liù diǎn.
examples.english: It's six thirty now, not six.

examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá jiějiù le bèi bǎngjià de háizi.
examples.english: The police rescued the kidnapped child.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de jiànyì jiějiù le wǒmen de wēijī.
examples.english: Your advice saved us from the crisis.

examples.pinyin: Xià yī bān fēiwǎng Shànghǎi de fēijī jǐ diǎn qǐfēi?
examples.english: What time does the next flight to Shanghai take off?

examples.hanzi: 候鸟每年冬天都会飞往南方。
examples.pinyin: Hòuniǎo měinián dōngtiān dōu huì fēiwǎng nánfāng.
examples.english: Migratory birds fly south every winter.

examples.hanzi: 孩子不小心打碎了一个杯子。
examples.pinyin: Háizi bù xiǎoxīn dǎsuì le yī gè bēizi.
examples.english: The child accidentally smashed a cup.

examples.hanzi: 球打碎了邻居家的窗户。
examples.pinyin: Qiú dǎsuì le línjū jiā de chuānghu.
examples.english: The ball broke the neighbor's window.

examples.pinyin: Yùdào wēixiǎn shí, nǐ yǒu quán zìwèi.
examples.english: When in danger, you have the right to defend yourself.

examples.hanzi: 法律允许人们正当自卫。
examples.pinyin: Fǎlǜ yǔnxǔ rénmen zhèngdàng zìwèi.
examples.english: The law allows people to act in legitimate self-defense.

examples.hanzi: 这条大路通向市中心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo dàlù tōngxiàng shì zhōngxīn.
examples.english: This main road leads to the city center.

examples.hanzi: 努力是通向成功的唯一道路。
examples.pinyin: Nǔlì shì tōngxiàng chénggōng de wéiyī dàolù.
examples.english: Hard work is the only road leading to success.

examples.hanzi: 他们在街上张贴了演唱会的海报。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài jiē shàng zhāngtiē le yǎnchànghuì de hǎibào.
examples.english: They put up posters for the concert on the street.

examples.hanzi: 我的房间里挂着很多乐队的海报。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān lǐ guà zhe hěn duō yuèduì de hǎibào.
examples.english: My room has many posters of bands hanging in it.

examples.hanzi: 警察在现场拉起了警戒线。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zài xiànchǎng lā qǐ le jǐngjièxiàn.
examples.english: The police put up a cordon at the scene.

examples.hanzi: 台风来临前，沿海地区进入了警戒状态。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng láilín qián, yánhǎi dìqū jìnrù le jǐngjiè zhuàngtài.
examples.english: Before the typhoon, coastal areas went on alert.

examples.hanzi: 她的眼睛闪亮着快乐的光芒。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yǎnjing shǎnliàng zhe kuàilè de guāngmáng.
examples.english: Her eyes sparkled with a joyful light.

examples.hanzi: 舞台上的灯光闪亮，观众都站了起来。
examples.pinyin: Wǔtái shàng de dēngguāng shǎnliàng, guānzhòng dōu zhàn le qǐlái.
examples.english: The stage lights flashed brightly and the audience stood up.

examples.hanzi: 顺着这条路一直走，就能看到医院。
examples.pinyin: Shùn zhe zhè tiáo lù yīzhí zǒu, jiù néng kàndào yīyuàn.
examples.english: Follow this road straight and you'll see the hospital.

examples.hanzi: 水顺着屋檐流了下来。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ shùn zhe wūyán liú le xiàlái.
examples.english: Water ran down along the eaves.

examples.hanzi: 老虎悄悄地接近自己的猎物。
examples.pinyin: Lǎohǔ qiāoqiāo de jiējìn zìjǐ de lièwù.
examples.english: The tiger quietly approached its prey.

examples.hanzi: 猎人带着猎物回到了村子。
examples.pinyin: Lièrén dài zhe lièwù huí dào le cūnzi.
examples.english: The hunter returned to the village with his catch.

examples.hanzi: 我饿得要命，快给我点吃的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ è de yàomìng, kuài gěi wǒ diǎn chī de.
examples.english: I'm starving, so quickly get me something to eat.

examples.hanzi: 这个药苦得要命，我吃不下去。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yào kǔ de yàomìng, wǒ chī bù xiàqù.
examples.english: This medicine is terribly bitter and I can't swallow it.

examples.hanzi: 他是那次沉船事故的唯一幸存者。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì nà cì chénchuán shìgù de wéiyī xìngcún zhě.
examples.english: He was the only survivor of that shipwreck.

examples.hanzi: 这座古建筑奇迹般地幸存了下来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔ jiànzhù qíjì bān de xìngcún le xiàlái.
examples.english: This old building survived miraculously.

examples.hanzi: 每个月的十五号是我们开会的日子。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè yuè de shíwǔ hào shì wǒmen kāihuì de rìzi.
examples.english: The fifteenth of each month is our meeting day.

examples.hanzi: 他今年十五岁，已经很高了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīnnián shíwǔ suì, yǐjīng hěn gāo le.
examples.english: He is fifteen this year and already very tall.

examples.hanzi: 裁判吹哨说他犯规了。
examples.pinyin: Cáipàn chuīshào shuō tā fànguī le.
examples.english: The referee blew his whistle and said he had committed a foul.

examples.hanzi: 开车闯红灯是犯规的行为。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē chuǎng hóngdēng shì fànguī de xíngwéi.
examples.english: Running a red light while driving is breaking the rules.

examples.hanzi: 这是一个常规的检查，不用担心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè chángguī de jiǎnchá, bù yòng dānxīn.
examples.english: This is a routine checkup, so don't worry.

examples.hanzi: 他的做法打破了常规。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zuòfǎ dǎpò le chángguī.
examples.english: His approach broke with convention.

examples.hanzi: 我们需要改善办公室的环境。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào gǎishàn bàngōngshì de huánjìng.
examples.english: We need to improve the office environment.

examples.hanzi: 多吃蔬菜可以改善你的健康状况。
examples.pinyin: Duō chī shūcài kěyǐ gǎishàn nǐ de jiànkāng zhuàngkuàng.
examples.english: Eating more vegetables can improve your health.

examples.hanzi: 酒后不要开车，要叫代驾。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ hòu bù yào kāichē, yào jiào dàijià.
examples.english: Don't drive after drinking, call a designated driver.

examples.hanzi: 他酒后说了很多心里话。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiǔ hòu shuō le hěn duō xīnlǐhuà.
examples.english: After drinking, he said many things from the heart.
